description:
Target profile: the target record with its known drugs, pathways, significant adverse-event reactions and mouse phenotypes, each section read on its own.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target — one record = one Ensembl human gene.
Key: id.
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
pathways: mixed direct and propagated annotations.
go: direct annotations only.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Every Ensembl human gene in Open Targets 25.09 (existence only).
Diseases, expression and interactions are not part of this view: use association.get_associations_for_target, expression.query_expression_by_gene and interaction.get_interactions.

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
